Algo King historical market data

Option archive: TradeMarkk / india-index-options-1m. https://huggingface.co/datasets/thetrademarkk/india-index-options-1m, revision 0f4800e43e6f96cec0794369d78eb4d3c4211ef5. CC BY-NC 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/. Filtered to positive-volume observed OHLC and repacked for private, noncommercial research.

Additional expired option research: rissin/nse-options-intraday, Upstox historical data, and authenticated FYERS where available. https://huggingface.co/datasets/rissin/nse-options-intraday
